items.title: Clear pre-existing design_check findings in index.html
items.summary: design_check exits 2 on main with 14 findings, so any UI checkpoint's design gate fails until cleared. 11x border-accent-on-rounded on the kbd keycap style (line 50; keycap bottom border is conventional: suppress narrowly with impeccable hooks ignore-value --reason, do not loosen the command). Real: .disc disclaimer 11px at 3.0:1 contrast (#9a8670 on #f6eedd, line 51; needs >=12px and 4.5:1); .card:before 8px top stripe flagged as side-tab (line 19; restyle or suppress with a reason).

items.title: Readability and accessibility polish after real-towns
items.summary: From the real-towns design critique (inbox/feature-design-critique.json): wrap long toasts and speech bubbles instead of overflowing or squeezing (client/hud.js toasts, client/render.js bubbles fillText maxWidth); aria-pressed and a non-colour cue on the mode buttons (index.html .mode, client/main.js setMode); scrutiny panel compact rule for 667x375 and 320x568; move ambient auto colours away from TDP yellow; reduced-motion for stone/fire shakes; focus to Play after a run; scrutiny copy 'nominations' not 'papers'.
